meaning: Scientific necessity and source-contract review accepted; no model execution or resource outcome is certified.
necessity: The strongest completed quality anchor is Qwen SeqFT. Measuring its original graph on the same five fixed raw-input windows fills a real resource-comparison gap regardless of the separate ARC outcome. This is a baseline measurement, not a new compression method.
review_scope: Read all three sources and protocol, plus the inherited checkpoint loader, SeqLinear, input preparation, frozen-vision transport and reused readout paths. AST/compile only; no module/model execution.

Original trusted full graph is restored once by checkpoints.load with sealed checkpoint/config/source binding; original CPU/CUDA tags are retained through physicalGPU1 mapped to virtualCUDA0. No from_pretrained reconstruction, fold, dtype conversion of weights, new backend or generation-config replacement is introduced.

56 native q/v-r8 modules,112 FP32 A/B tensors,1089536 adapter coordinates and original FP16 base are explicitly checked. Original mixed layout is2210075136 coefficients/4422329344 weightbytes plus7504 registered-bufferbytes.

The GPU visual-preparation branch distinguishes a2D hidden1536 feature matrix from a2D raw patch matrix by its last dimension. Native raw patches of width1176 enter the original extractor, rather than the ndim-only shortcut used for OneVision. Features are prepared on GPU with no visual LRU retention.

Original processor/template/EOS/pad and generation objects are retained. The same five hash-selected raw QA contracts, image SHA/dimensions, context retrieval and401408 area policy are bound to the existing OneVision resource proof. Native prepared tensors are allowed to differ.

Peak windows reset/synchronize/empty-cache before input and visual preparation and fixed greedy32-token generation. There is no DEV prewarm, NLL, F1, backward or optimizer step. The controller launches one isolated worker, records its exit, and then runs metadata verification once.

The worker identity/UUID,600-second model alarm, original state/registered-buffer/adapter-structure and public generation invariants are checked; this measurement neither modifies nor schedules ARC GPU2 work.
limits: Original unfolded FP16-base/FP32-adapter graph is a real implementation reference, not an equally folded or optimally deployed precision-matched bound.
Native processors, tokenization, visual grids and prepared matrices differ legitimately across backbones; only raw input contracts are matched.
Five fixed32-token allocated/reserved-memory windows do not establish full-distribution worst-case memory, latency or throughput.
Checkpoint-container bytes, complete weight bytes, CPU checkpoint/cache metadata and actual GPU peaks are separate quantities; CPU metadata bytes are not RSS.
Original formal training may have seen these DEV inputs. No quality is measured or selected here; resource evidence cannot establish new-method F1 superiority.
A smaller OneVision graph or lower measured peak would not by itself be a structural innovation or completion of the joint F1/resource goal.
authorship_disclosure: Reviewer authored the separate ARC common/worker/controller and protocol, and previously helped implement the inherited plain readout/deployment pipeline. Reviewer did not author these Qwen resource worker/verify/controller sources and did not execute a model or scorer for this review.
